Here's a comprehensive 2-week itinerary for your trip to Egypt, packed with historical sites, museums, and cultural experiences! 🌍✨

---

**Day 1 — Arrival in Cairo**

Morning
• Arrive at Cairo International Airport, transfer to your hotel — check-in and freshen up.

Lunch
• Local restaurant in Zamalek — try traditional Egyptian dishes.

Afternoon
• The Egyptian Museum — 2-3 hours — Home to the world’s largest collection of ancient Egyptian antiquities, including treasures of Tutankhamun. Buy your tickets in advance to avoid queues.

Evening
• Dinner at a Nile-view restaurant, enjoying traditional live music.

---

**Day 2 — Historical Cairo**

Morning
• Citadel of Saladin — 1.5 hours — Explore the impressive fortress and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali.

Lunch
• Local café in Islamic Cairo — enjoy some koshari (a popular Egyptian dish).

Afternoon
• Khan El Khalili Bazaar — 2 hours — Stroll through this bustling market filled with spices, textiles, and souvenirs.

Evening
• Visit the Ben Ezra Synagogue — 1 hour — Discover the history behind this medieval synagogue.

---

**Day 3 — Giza Pyramids**

Morning
• Great Pyramids of Giza — 3 hours — Marvel at the iconic pyramids and the Great Sphinx. Arrive early to beat the crowds!

Lunch
• Nearby local restaurant — sample Egyptian falafel (ta'ameya).

Afternoon
• Solar Barque Museum — 1 hour — Explore the ancient solar boat found near the Great Pyramid.

Evening
• Sound and Light Show at the Pyramids — enjoy the spectacular storytelling of ancient Egypt.

---

**Day 4 — Saqqara and Memphis**

Morning
• Saqqara Necropolis — 3 hours — Visit the Step Pyramid of Djoser and other ancient tombs.

Lunch
• Restaurant in Saqqara — enjoy a traditional meal.

Afternoon
• Memphis Open-Air Museum — 1.5 hours — Explore ancient Memphis, the first capital of Egypt.

Evening
• Return to Cairo for dinner and rest.

---

**Day 5 — Luxor Travel**

Morning
• Flight to Luxor — transfer to your hotel upon arrival.

Lunch
• Local restaurant in Luxor — taste regional specialties.

Afternoon
• Luxor Temple — 1.5 hours — Explore this magnificent temple, beautifully lit at night.

Evening
• Stroll along the Corniche and dinner at a riverside restaurant.

---

**Day 6 — Valley of the Kings**

Morning
• Valley of the Kings — 3-4 hours — Discover the tombs of famous pharaohs, including Tutankhamun. Make sure to get a ticket for the tombs you're most interested in!

Lunch
• Local café near the Valley — quick Egyptian snacks.

Afternoon
• Temple of Hatshepsut — 2 hours — Visit this stunning mortuary temple dedicated to Egypt’s first female pharaoh.

Evening
• Evening free for leisure or optional hot air balloon ride (if desired).

---

**Day 7 — Karnak Temple**

Morning
• Karnak Temple — 3 hours — Explore the vast temple complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world.

Lunch
• Local restaurant in Luxor — enjoy a lunch featuring grilled meats.

Afternoon
• Luxor Museum — 1.5 hours — View artifacts from the Theban temples and necropolis.

Evening
• Dinner at a local eatery with traditional music.

---

**Day 8 — Aswan Travel**

Morning
• Train to Aswan — enjoy scenic views along the Nile.

Lunch
• Arrival and check-in at your hotel in Aswan — local restaurant for lunch.

Afternoon
• Philae Temple — 2 hours — Visit this beautiful temple dedicated to the goddess Isis.

Evening
• Dinner on a felucca (traditional sailboat) — enjoy the sunset on the Nile.

---

**Day 9 — Abu Simbel**

Morning
• Abu Simbel excursion (by bus or private tour) — 3 hours — Explore the majestic temples of Ramses II. An early start is recommended!

Lunch
• Packed lunch or local restaurant near Abu Simbel.

Afternoon
• Return to Aswan — relax at your hotel or enjoy a Nile-side café.

Evening
• Visit the Nubian Museum — 1.5 hours — Learn about Aswan's Nubian heritage.

---

**Day 10 — Kalabsha Temple**

Morning
• Kalabsha Temple — 2 hours — Visit this ancient temple moved from Lake Nasser.

Lunch
• Local restaurant in Aswan — enjoy Nubian cuisine.

Afternoon
• Unfinished Obelisk — 1 hour — View the largest known ancient obelisk.

Evening
• Dinner and leisure time.

---

**Day 11 — Return to Cairo**

Morning
• Flight back to Cairo — check into your hotel.

Lunch
• Local restaurant — enjoy some grilled meats and salads.

Afternoon
• Museum of Islamic Art — 2 hours — Explore one of the world’s greatest collections of Islamic art.

Evening
• Free evening to explore local nightlife or relax at the hotel.

---

**Day 12 — Alexandria Day Trip**

Morning
• Travel to Alexandria (about 2.5 hours) — visit the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa.

Lunch
• Local seafood restaurant on the waterfront.

Afternoon
• Bibliotheca Alexandrina — 1.5 hours — Explore this remarkable modern library and cultural center.

Evening
• Return to Cairo and dinner at a local restaurant.

---

**Day 13 — Free Day in Cairo**

Morning
• Free time for shopping, relaxing, or revisiting favorite sites.

Lunch
• Local eatery or café.

Afternoon
• Optional visit to the Coptic Museum or more shopping.

Evening
• Farewell dinner at a traditional restaurant.

---

**Day 14 — Departure**

Morning
• Check out from the hotel and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure.

---

**Travel Tips**
- Ensure you have Egyptian pounds (EGP) for local purchases; many places accept cash only.
- Wear comfortable shoes as you’ll be doing a lot of walking!
- Always carry a bottle of water, especially while sightseeing.
- Check the opening hours of attractions in advance to plan your visits.
